# Crewlo

> Your agents. A studio of their own.
> A local desktop workspace for coding-agent CLIs, with an original voxel studio,
> missions, agent activity, conversations and optional paired-owner messaging.
> Current version: 0.4.6 (development preview, September 2026).

## Status

- Windows: unsigned installer built and checked locally; clean-PC and uninstall validation remain open.
- Codex: real temporary-file reading response verified through packaged IPC and PTY, not a full hive acceptance test.
- macOS: universal DMG/ZIP configuration reviewed; no Mac build or runtime validation.
- Linux: runtime and installer not validated.
- Telegram: one documented basic live message round trip; reconstructed phone demo.
- WhatsApp: experimental Meta Cloud API integration; simulated tests, no verified live delivery.
- Website: illustrated missions and agents, not recordings of live work.
- Public Windows x64 preview: https://github.com/HafidIdrissi/crewlo/releases/tag/v0.4.6-preview.1. No active automatic update feed.

Workspace state is local. Agent providers can receive prompts and code; Telegram and Meta process channel messages. Local-first does not mean offline-only.
